[Section] System Architecture and Training
[source_id=48] We implement the translation systems using OpenNMT-py framework BIBREF16 . Our system architecture includes two bi-directional LSTM layers for the encoder and two LSTM layers for the decoder, each layer has the size of 512 hidden units. The size of source and target embedding layers is also 512. We use Adam optimizer BIBREF17 and learning rate annealing scheme with the initial learning rate at INLINEFORM0 . We train each systems for 15 epochs with the batch size of 64. The best model in term of the unigram accuracy on the validation set is usually used to translate the test set with beam size of 16. Other settings are the default settings of OpenNMT-py, otherwise already noted.
